== Rules ==
* Map order: 
- All matches are Best of 5 (BO5). Grand Finals are Best of 7 (BO7).

Use /cmd rnd to decide who picks first (Team 1).

Pick order: T1 → T2 → losing team picks next.

“Losing team” means the one trailing in total maps (e.g., 0–2 or 1–2), or if tied (1–1 or 2–2), the one who lost the previous map. A map cannot be played twice.

* Scheduling: '''IMPORTANT!''' In order to get this tournament completed before the holidays each round of the bracket must be completed within a week of it's posting. If your opponents are unable to schedule within a week you must reach out to Bance with a time that you will be playing within 2 days of the end of week or a walkover will be awarded.
* Settings: Standard settings by typing "/2on2" | To add match tag type "/2on2 NAQL 2on2"
* Pause rules: Each player is allowed one pause per match, once you have used a pause and use it again, you have forfeited the map.
* Ping rules: Find a server that keeps all players around the same ping, if no such server can be found, the lowest ping players will have to use cl_delay_packet to get closer to the higher ping players. If there's a dispute in what server should be used, contact admin on discord. For teams/players outside of NA you can request your best server but cannot expect opponents to ping up.
* Client: ezquake 3.6.x. or unezquake 1.3.x. For your own sake, update your client!
** Remember to check with f_version
* Reporting: send screenshots in #na-quakeworld-draft on the discord unless BD makes me a new channel.
* cl_idrive is NOT allowed, turn off your hardware SOCD functions if you have them.
